doc.name: G — 30s rain-day comfort story set in a university campus, melancholic in tone, a product as the hero object, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: rain-day comfort story set in a university campus, melancholic in tone
Hero: a product as the hero object
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the rain-day comfort story set in a university campus, melancholic in tone form, built around a product as the hero object.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. The hero prop introduced in Act 1 must be physically present in Acts 2 and 3.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a vertigo/dolly-zoom counter-move holding the subject size constant in Act 1 against a locked-off static frame where only the subject moves in Act 3 — while holding the a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second rain-day comfort story set in a university campus, melancholic in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same product as the hero object.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a slow dolly-in that closes about a third of the distance, shot on an 85mm short telephoto at f/1.4, framed with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with underlighting from a translucent base panel; grade as a pastel low-contrast grade with a lifted black point. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, and low quality.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distort, low quality, plastic skin, waxy highlights

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second rain-day comfort story set in a university campus, melancholic in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same product as the hero object.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distort, low quality, warped product label, unreadable logo

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second rain-day comfort story set in a university campus, melancholic in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same product as the hero object.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a locked-off static frame where only the subject moves, shot on an 8mm circular fisheye at f/2.8, framed with leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with flickering firelight as the only motivated source; grade as a pastel low-contrast grade with a lifted black point. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distortion, low quality, warped text, extra limbs.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.negative_prompt: low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear
